requiredContractsAndWitnesses.contract: Authorized useful Astral arrival and movement
requiredContractsAndWitnesses.missing: An authorized Astral site/endpoint record, actual arrival selection, occupied-body fit, support/environment, usable movement/senses/actions, navigation and onward-transit limits, with actual endpoint restrictions. Neither the named Astral destination nor mortal teachings supply these operational measurements or permissions.
requiredContractsAndWitnesses.minimumRecord: Bind a specifically authorized Astral site and arrival rule with provenance, plane/site IDs, geometry and supporting/environmental facts, legal arrival footprints and allowed useful interactions. A bounded new operating record must be expressly authored and labeled; this return selects no site, topology, speed, respiration rule or travel permission.

requiredContractsAndWitnesses.contract: One participant identity, explicit body relation and conserved custody
requiredContractsAndWitnesses.missing: The relation of original and projected bodies: existence/location/anatomy/needs, awareness/control, vulnerability, targetability and source loci; one actor schedule and resource/history ledger; exact body-local HP/conditions and item/component/ammunition/charge/passenger allocation. Generic forms or local scene projections do not define this spell.
requiredContractsAndWitnesses.minimumRecord: An explicit Astral Projection-local body/resource/custody specification, including admitted and excluded recipient categories, per-body capabilities and access to actual gear, damage/healing mapping, and once-only use/consumption/transfer. No independent copied actor, soul, budget or saleable projected matter is authorized.

requiredContractsAndWitnesses.contract: Continuing result and finite individual/cohort ending
requiredContractsAndWitnesses.missing: An explicit continuing-result duration/concentration/ending contract consistent with printed Instantaneous initiation: individual return while companions continue, source loci, both elapsed timelines, original-body movement/confinement/loss/death, injury/zero/death/Null/Hunt, suppression/dispel/replacement, safe finite return-fit conflict and exact surviving cargo settlement.
requiredContractsAndWitnesses.minimumRecord: Define these spell-local transitions and per-member/parent dependencies without importing a silver cord, stasis, arbitrary cap, Banishment/scene-cell terminal rescue, planar time conversion or automatic safe return. Evaluate actual acquired wards/removals only after the body/transaction model is defined; keep real costs, elapsed deadlines and ended records, with no refund/refill/duplicate return.

requiredContractsAndWitnesses.contract: Complete paid useful multi-participant witness and adverse branches
requiredContractsAndWitnesses.missing: No complete paid Astral Projection encounter with legal acquisition, actual authorized site facts, multiple distinct willing companions, useful movement/action/item use, independent companion return and continued cohort activity is supplied.
requiredContractsAndWitnesses.minimumRecord: After W01-W03 are bound, demonstrate legal caster repertoire/preparation, profile and resources; exact 26-base-RP final paid cost/cadence and Counterspell history; participants/consent/range/fit; both clocks and one schedule; real movement and item/component expenditure; one independent return while others continue; original-body movement/confinement/loss, actual ward predicates, injury/qualifying Null, suppression and return conflict with once-only custody. Supply full before/after states, reversible operations and separate semantic verification. Conditional authored fixtures must be identified and not attributed to the user or claimed as campaign/observed play.

wholeIdentityGate: Missing central projection/travel content and paid useful encounter, not merely an optional external boundary branch.
minimumNextAction: Prepare one explicitly labeled Astral Projection operating-specification closure delta covering W01-W03 with authorized site/body facts; then W04. No unchanged replay or unrelated source search is requested.
